jobs.occupation: Warehouse Operator / Reach Truck Driver – 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Are you someone who enjoys working in a warehouse and likes a varied working day? Do you have experience operating a reach truck, but also enjoy getting hands-on with order picking and other warehouse activities? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities

As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You ensure that goods are handled, moved and prepared for shipment correctly and efficiently.

Your duties will include:

• Picking orders and preparing them for shipment.

• Receiving and checking incoming goods.

• Storing products in the correct warehouse locations.

• Moving goods and pallets using a reach truck, for both inbound and outbound operations.

• Occasionally loading and unloading trucks using a forklift.

• Labelling products and registering them correctly in the system.

• Maintaining a clean, safe and well-organised working environment.

 

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys a varied warehouse role and is flexible when it comes to different tasks.

In addition, you meet the following requirements:

• You have initial work experience as a reach truck operator.

• You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English, both spoken and written.

• You are comfortable working with numbers and counting accurately.

• You are available to start at short notice.

• You are willing to perform various warehouse tasks, including operating the reach truck, order picking and checking goods.

• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

The Logistics Centre in Grimbergen is recognized as one of the world's leading facilities, reflecting the company's commitment to excellence across all operations.

Jobomschrijving

jobs.occupation: Coördinator Internal Sales | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage. 
 
• You have your own transportation, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - Medior Business Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
• Position: Business Functional Analyst

• Domain: Business Analysis / IT & Application Projects

• Seniority: Medior (3-5 years of experience)

• Working environment: Collaboration with business stakeholders, IT teams, Project Managers and external partners.

• Location : Bruxelles

• English: Fluent.

• Fluent in French and/or Dutch

Business Functional Analyst

We are looking for an experienced Business Functional Analyst to join an established team and help translate business needs into effective technology solutions.

In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Project Managers, IT teams, external partners and vendors to understand business challenges, clarify requirements and support the successful delivery of functional solutions.

You will play a key role throughout the project lifecycle, from initial analysis and requirements gathering to solution design, testing, implementation and post-go-live support.

You combine strong analytical and communication skills with a pragmatic mindset. Beyond documenting business requests, you seek to understand the underlying needs, challenge assumptions constructively and contribute to defining the right solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Business & functional analysis:

• Facilitate workshops, interviews and working sessions with business stakeholders to understand objectives, challenges and requirements.

• Analyse and document current and future business processes, business rules, data flows and system interactions.

• Challenge business requests where appropriate and translate needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria.

• Assess impacts, dependencies and risks, ensuring alignment between business objectives, technical feasibility and project scope.

• Functional design & documentation:

• Create process models, functional design documents, data mappings, mock-ups and prototypes where needed.

• Support solution design and collaborate closely with development, architecture, vendor and testing teams to define fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Maintain clear functional documentation and requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

• Bridge between business & IT:

• Act as a key point of contact for functional questions throughout design, development, testing and implementation.

• Work closely with Project Managers, Developers and Test Engineers, supporting scope clarification, impact assessments, dependencies and requirement-related risks.

• Ensure that decisions and requirements are clearly understood across business and IT teams, from initial analysis through deployment.

• Testing & validation:

• Prepare functional test scenarios and support regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), in collaboration with the Test Engineer.

• Support business users during UAT and validate that delivered solutions meet agreed business and functional requirements.

• Analyse defects and root causes with business and technical teams and contribute to appropriate corrective actions.

• Continuous improvement:

• Proactively identify process improvements, automation opportunities and system enhancements.

• Support change and rollout activities, including documentation, training materials and business readiness where required.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions and help shape the evolution of the application landscape.

Professional experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

• 3-5 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst or similar analytical and process-oriented IT project role

• Proven experience in requirements analysis, functional design or software implementation

• Hands-on experience with business process modelling and functional documentation, including use cases, user stories and acceptance criteria

• Experience supporting end-to-end solution delivery

 

Technical & functional knowledge:

• Familiarity with tools and systems such as:

• 

• Azure DevOps

• Confluence

• ERP solutions

• Microsoft 365

• Comfortable working with data-related concepts, integrations and APIs

• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into clear functional requirements

• Experience supporting testing and validation activities

Personal profile

We are looking for someone who is:

• Analytical, structured and solution-oriented

• Self-motivated, curious and proactive

• Flexible and comfortable adapting to change

• Able to anticipate needs, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions constructively

• Capable of bringing structure to ambiguous situations

• Reliable and able to manage priorities effectively

• Comfortable moving between business discussions and detailed functional conversations with IT teams

• An effective communicator who can manage complex stakeholder interactions diplomatically and professionally

• Collaborative, with a strong team spirit and willingness to share knowledge

• Interested in continuous learning and professional development
